name: maanasa-portfolio-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for inspecting Maanasa Narayan's software engineering portfolio, experience, skills, and projects.
instructions: This MCP server provides read-only access to Maanasa Narayan's software engineering portfolio data including profile, work experience at Google/Kayak/Amazon/Nokia/Adobe, technical skills, and featured projects. All tools are safe, read-only operations.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve biographical background, current role at Google, education, and social links.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Retrieve work history, roles, dates, and responsibilities at Google, Kayak, Amazon, Nokia, and Adobe.

company.description: Optional company name to filter experience (e.g. "Google", "Kayak")

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Retrieve technical skills categorised by Languages, Backend & Cloud, and Frontend & Tools.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Retrieve featured projects, architecture details, and accomplishments.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Answer natural language questions about Maanasa's engineering experience and background.

query.description: The natural language question to ask about Maanasa's background
